fullDescription: Warm pastel SaaS landing on a cream field with a sky-blue + coral two-tone gradient, all in Poppins, anchored by a centered white rounded-5xl dual-CTA card floating with a soft two-tone shadow, inner glows, bobbing decor squares, a sky-gradient primary pill beside a coral-outline secondary, and a gradient-clipped headline phrase.
prompt:
## Resumo
A soft pastel SaaS landing page whose star is a centered dual-CTA card on a cream field. It reads as a real page top to bottom: a glass blurred sticky nav (a sky-to-coral gradient sparkle logo tile + 'Lumina' wordmark, four muted links, a dark-ink 'Start free' pill), a centered intro strip on a tinted mesh+grain background (a frosted star-four pill eyebrow, a huge Poppins 800 headline 'From a sentence to a shippable UI' with a sky-to-coral gradient-clipped phrase, and a muted subhead), then the anchor: a big white rounded-5xl card (rounded 2.75rem) floating on cream with a soft sky/coral two-tone drop shadow, a 1px white border, a hairline ring, two inner blurred glows (sky top-left, coral bottom-right), and small floating decor squares around it. Inside the card, centered: an overlapping avatar proof row with a +9k chip and 'builders shipping with Lumina', a Poppins 800 headline 'Build your first design this afternoon' (gradient-clipped phrase), a muted subhead, a dual button row (a sky-gradient primary pill 'Start free' with lightning + arrow icons beside a white coral-outlined secondary 'Book a demo'), and a three-item check-circle reassurance row. A tiny footnote sits under the card, and the page closes on a cream mini footer (gradient logo, copyright, three social icons).

## Estilo Visual
Build a warm pastel SaaS landing whose anchor is a centered dual-CTA card on a cream field. Palette is cream + ink + a sky/coral two-tone gradient: cream #fdf9f3 (page bg), ink #27303f (all dark headings), muted #6b7280 (body/subheads), sky #38bdf8 (shades 600 #0ea5e9, 700 #0284c7, 800 #075985, 900 #0c4a6e) and coral #fb7185 (shades 600 #f43f5e, 700 #be123c, 800 #9f1239) as the paired accents. Use the two accents together as gradients, never as flat blocks: a .gradient-text utility clips a linear-gradient(100deg, #075985 0%, #0284c7 42%, #be123c 100%) onto the hero headline phrase; the logo tile is bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral; the primary button is bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-800 to-sky-900; the secondary is a white pill with a coral-700/35 border and coral-700 text. One Google font: Poppins (400;500;600;700;800) as the sans for everything, with display headlines at font-800 + tracking-tight (hero text-[40px] sm:text-[52px] leading-[1.05]; card h2 text-[34px] sm:text-[46px] leading-[1.08]) and body at the muted gray. Layer soft texture and depth everywhere: a .grain dot overlay (radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(39,48,63,0.05) 1px, transparent 0) at 22px 22px), a .mesh tri-radial pastel tint behind the intro (sky/22 top-left, coral/20 top-right, sky/16 bottom-center, each fading to transparent), a frosted .nav-blur (backdrop-filter: saturate(160%) blur(12px)) glass nav at bg-cream/80 with a border-ink/5 bottom border, generous radii (rounded-4xl 2rem, rounded-5xl 2.75rem), and a soft hairline .ring-soft (box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(39,48,63,0.06)). The STAR is a big white rounded-5xl card (border border-white bg-white/90 p-8 sm:p-12 lg:p-16) floating on cream with a two-tone diffuse shadow (.shadow-card = 0 32px 80px -32px rgba(56,189,248,0.30), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(251,113,133,0.18)) plus .ring-soft, with two inner pointer-events-none blurred glows (an h-56 w-56 sky/20 rounded-full blur-3xl at -left-16 -top-16, a coral/20 one at -bottom-20 -right-10) and small floating decor squares (sky/15, coral/20, sky/20 rounded tiles that .float-slow / .float-slower bob via a translateY keyframe). Buttons are pillowy: primary = a rounded-2xl sky-gradient pill with a .shadow-btn (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(14,165,233,0.55)) glow, an inset white/15 ring, an inner top white/5 sheen, a leading ph:lightning-fill and trailing ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges on hover, lifting -translate-y-0.5; secondary = a white rounded-2xl coral-outline pill with .shadow-btn-coral (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(244,63,94,0.40)) and a ph:calendar-check-fill icon. Eyebrow + chips are frosted: the intro eyebrow is a rounded-full bg-white/70 ring-soft pill with a sky-800 ph:star-four-fill; the proof row is overlapping avatar circles (sky, coral, ink) with white rings plus a cream +9k chip. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph) used warmly. Antialiased, smooth-scroll, text-rendering optimizeLegibility. Keep it soft and airy everywhere, no hard edges, no second loud block; gradients and glows carry the energy. No em-dashes in copy.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Glass sticky nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) wrapping a frosted bar: a div with .nav-blur (backdrop-filter: saturate(160%) blur(12px)), bg-cream/80, and a border-b border-ink/5. Inside a mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 nav, a flex h-[68px] items-center justify-between row: LEFT = a brand link (flex items-center gap-2.5) with a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl gradient tile (bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral, text-white, grid place-items-center, .shadow-card-sm) holding a ph:sparkle-fill icon (20px), beside a 19px font-700 tracking-tight 'Lumina' wordmark; CENTER (hidden md:flex, gap-9) = four 15px font-500 text-muted links 'Prompts / Canvas / Library / Pricing' that go to text-ink on hover (transition); RIGHT (flex items-center gap-3) = a 15px font-500 text-muted 'Sign in' text link (hidden, sm:block) and a rounded-full bg-ink px-5 py-2.5 14px font-600 text-cream 'Start free' pill (.shadow-chip, hover:bg-ink/90) linking to #cta.

### Centered intro strip (mesh + grain)
A relative overflow-hidden section with .mesh (a tri-radial pastel tint: sky/22 at 18% 12%, coral/20 at 88% 22%, sky/16 at 50% 110%) and .grain (a faint ink dot overlay). Inside mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 pt-20 pb-10 text-center: an inline-flex rounded-full eyebrow pill (bg-white/70 px-4 py-1.5, 13px font-600 text-sky-800, .ring-soft) with a leading 15px ph:star-four-fill and 'The AI design agent on an infinite canvas'. Then a mx-auto mt-7 max-w-3xl Poppins h1 (font-800 tracking-tight, leading-[1.05], text-[40px] sm:text-[52px]) 'From a sentence to a ' + a .gradient-text whitespace-nowrap 'shippable UI'. Then a mx-auto mt-5 max-w-xl 17px leading-relaxed text-muted subhead: 'Describe it, watch it appear. Lumina turns plain-language prompts into mockups, components and full flows you can hand straight to code.'

### THE STAR: dual-CTA card section + floating decor
The anchor section (id='cta') relative overflow-hidden bg-cream pb-28 pt-6. First, three pointer-events-none floating decor tiles, hidden on mobile and lg:block: an h-16 w-16 rounded-3xl bg-sky/15 .ring-soft .float-slow at left-[6%] top-10; an h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-coral/20 .ring-soft .float-slower at right-[7%] top-24; an h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-sky/20 .ring-soft .float-slow at bottom-16 right-[16%] (.float-slow / .float-slower = a translateY(-10px) bob keyframe over 7s / 9s). Then a mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 holding the card: a relative overflow-hidden rounded-5xl border border-white bg-white/90 p-8 sm:p-12 lg:p-16 with .shadow-card (the two-tone sky+coral diffuse shadow) and .ring-soft. Inside the card, two pointer-events-none inner glows: an absolute -left-16 -top-16 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-sky/20 blur-3xl and an absolute -bottom-20 -right-10 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-coral/20 blur-3xl. All card content sits in a relative text-center wrapper above the glows.

### Proof avatar row + payoff headline + subhead
Inside the card, centered: a mb-7 flex items-center justify-center gap-3 proof row = a flex -space-x-2 stack of three 32px (h-8 w-8) avatar circles with white ring-2 (a sky one 'A', a coral one 'J', an ink one 'M', each white 12px font-700), then a -ml-1 cream +9k chip (grid h-8 min-w-[2.5rem] px-2 place-items-center rounded-full bg-cream text-ink ring-2 ring-white 12px font-700 .shadow-chip), then a 14px font-500 text-muted 'builders shipping with Lumina'. Then a mx-auto max-w-2xl Poppins h2 (font-800 tracking-tight, leading-[1.08], text-[34px] sm:text-[46px]) 'Build your first design ' + a .gradient-text whitespace-nowrap 'this afternoon'. Then a mx-auto mt-5 max-w-lg 17px leading-relaxed text-muted subhead: 'Start free, no card needed. Or grab a guided walkthrough and we will set you up. Either way, you will have something real on the canvas in minutes.'

### Dual button row (two paths)
A mt-10 flex flex-col items-stretch justify-center gap-3.5 row that becomes sm:flex-row sm:items-center. PRIMARY = a sky-gradient pill 'Start free': group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-800 to-sky-900 px-8 py-4 16px font-700 text-white, .shadow-btn (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(14,165,233,0.55)), ring-1 ring-inset ring-white/15, with an inner top sheen (a pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1/2 bg-white/[0.05]), a leading 20px ph:lightning-fill, the label, and a trailing 18px ph:arrow-right-bold that translate-x-0.5 on group-hover; hover deepens the gradient and -translate-y-0.5. SECONDARY = a white coral-outline pill 'Book a demo': group inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-coral-700/35 bg-white px-8 py-4 16px font-700 text-coral-700, .shadow-btn-coral (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(244,63,94,0.40)), a 20px ph:calendar-check-fill icon; hover:border-coral-700 hover:bg-coral/5 -translate-y-0.5.

### Reassurance check row + footnote
Below the buttons, a mt-7 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 reassurance row (13.5px font-500 text-muted) of three inline-flex items, each with a leading 16px text-sky-600 ph:check-circle-fill: 'Free forever plan', 'No credit card', 'Export to code'. Then, OUTSIDE the card, a mt-8 text-center 13.5px text-muted footnote: 'Trusted by indie hackers, design teams and the folks who would rather ship than fuss.'

### Cream mini footer
A footer with border-t border-ink/5 bg-cream. Inside mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 py-8: a flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 row. LEFT = a flex items-center gap-2.5 brand mark: a 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-lg gradient tile (bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral text-white) with a 15px ph:sparkle-fill, beside a 15px font-600 'Lumina'. CENTER = a 13px text-muted copyright 'Copyright 2026 Lumina Design. Made for people who ship.' RIGHT = a flex items-center gap-4 text-muted social row of three 20px Iconify links (ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo) that go to text-ink on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
The star is a big white card floating on cream that reads as a soft, lifted object: a relative overflow-hidden rounded-5xl (2.75rem radius) card with border border-white, bg-white/90, generous p-8 sm:p-12 lg:p-16, a hairline .ring-soft (box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(39,48,63,0.06)), and a big diffuse TWO-TONE drop shadow .shadow-card = 0 32px 80px -32px rgba(56,189,248,0.30) (sky) layered with 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(251,113,133,0.18) (coral), so the card glows softly in both accent colors at once. Inside, two pointer-events-none blurred glows bleed from the corners (an h-56 w-56 sky/20 rounded-full blur-3xl at -left-16 -top-16, a coral/20 one at -bottom-20 -right-10); overflow-hidden clips them to the rounded card edge. All content sits in a relative text-center wrapper above the glows.

### Componente
Two pillowy rounded-2xl buttons offered as two paths. PRIMARY = a sky-gradient pill: bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-800 #075985 to-sky-900 #0c4a6e, white font-700, a colored glow shadow .shadow-btn (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(14,165,233,0.55)), an inset ring-1 ring-white/15, an inner top sheen (absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1/2 bg-white/[0.05]) for a glossy top, a leading ph:lightning-fill and a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges translate-x-0.5 on group-hover; hover deepens the gradient (from-sky-900) and lifts -translate-y-0.5. SECONDARY = a quiet white coral-outline pill: bg-white, border border-coral-700/35, text-coral-700 font-700, a coral glow shadow .shadow-btn-coral (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(244,63,94,0.40)), a ph:calendar-check-fill icon; hover:border-coral-700 hover:bg-coral/5 and -translate-y-0.5. Only the primary is filled, so the two-path choice stays clear.

### Componente
A .gradient-text utility clips a warm two-accent gradient onto a single headline phrase (whitespace-nowrap so it never breaks mid-gradient): background linear-gradient(100deg, #075985 0%, #0284c7 42%, #be123c 100%) with -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent. Used to pop one phrase per headline ('shippable UI' in the hero, 'this afternoon' in the card) so the eye lands on the payoff word while the rest stays ink. The same sky-to-coral pairing appears as the logo tile gradient and informs the sky-gradient primary button.

### Componente
A translucent sticky header (.nav-blur = backdrop-filter: saturate(160%) blur(12px)) over bg-cream/80 with a border-b border-ink/5, so cream content shows softly through on scroll. The same frosted-on-light language repeats in chips: the intro eyebrow is a rounded-full bg-white/70 .ring-soft pill, and the card proof row ends in a cream +9k chip with a white ring-2 and .shadow-chip. The brand mark is a sky-to-coral gradient rounded tile + a Poppins wordmark; the right side ends in a solid dark-ink 'Start free' pill anchored to #cta.

### Componente
The intro strip gets soft atmosphere from two stacked background utilities: .mesh = three radial-gradients (sky/22 at 18% 12%, coral/20 at 88% 22%, sky/16 at 50% 110%, each fading to transparent by ~60%) for a faint two-tone pastel wash, plus .grain = a radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(39,48,63,0.05) 1px, transparent 0) tiled at 22px 22px for a fine paper texture. Together they tint and texture the area above the card without any hard color block, keeping the whole page soft and airy.

### Componente
Three small pointer-events-none rounded tiles bob gently around the card on large screens only (lg:block): an h-16 w-16 rounded-3xl bg-sky/15 at left-[6%] top-10, an h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-coral/20 at right-[7%] top-24, and an h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-sky/20 at bottom-16 right-[16%], each with a .ring-soft hairline. Two animation utilities drive them via a single @keyframes float (translateY(0) -> translateY(-10px) -> translateY(0)): .float-slow runs it over 7s, .float-slower over 9s, so the tiles drift at slightly different rhythms for a light, playful feel.

## Notas Especiais
Palette is cream + ink + a sky/coral two-tone gradient: cream #fdf9f3 (page), ink #27303f (headings), muted #6b7280 (body/subheads), and the paired accents sky #38bdf8 (shades 600 #0ea5e9, 700 #0284c7, 800 #075985, 900 #0c4a6e) and coral #fb7185 (shades 600 #f43f5e, 700 #be123c, 800 #9f1239). The two accents are always used TOGETHER as gradients/glows, never as flat color blocks: the .gradient-text headline phrase is linear-gradient(100deg, #075985 0%, #0284c7 42%, #be123c 100%); the logo tile and footer mark are bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral; the primary button is bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-800 to-sky-900; the card's signature shadow is two-tone (sky #38bdf8 at 0.30 + coral #fb7185 at 0.18). One Google font: Poppins (weights 400;500;600;700;800) for everything, headlines at font-800 + tracking-tight (hero 40/52px leading-1.05; card h2 34/46px leading-1.08), body at 17px text-muted. Icons are Iconify Phosphor: ph:sparkle-fill (logo), ph:star-four-fill (eyebrow), ph:lightning-fill + ph:arrow-right-bold (primary button), ph:calendar-check-fill (secondary), ph:check-circle-fill (reassurance row), ph:x-logo / ph:github-logo / ph:discord-logo (footer). Custom utilities carry the soft look: .grain (dot texture), .mesh (tri-radial pastel tint), .gradient-text (clipped headline gradient), .nav-blur (frosted nav), .ring-soft (1px hairline shadow), and @keyframes float with .float-slow (7s) / .float-slower (9s); custom radii rounded-4xl (2rem) / rounded-5xl (2.75rem); custom shadows shadow-card / shadow-card-sm / shadow-btn / shadow-btn-coral / shadow-chip. The signature language is a centered dual-CTA card floating on a cream field with a soft two-tone shadow, inner sky/coral glows, and bobbing decor squares, above it a mesh+grain-tinted intro strip, all in friendly rounded Poppins with one gradient-clipped headline phrase. To transfer the STYLE: keep cream + ink + the sky/coral two-tone gradient (used only as gradients/glows, never flat blocks), the single rounded Poppins font, the big soft two-tone card shadow + inner glows, the frosted glass nav/chips, the dot grain + pastel mesh texture, and the playful floating decor. To transfer the LAYOUT: keep the framed stack (glass sticky nav -> mesh+grain intro strip with frosted eyebrow + huge headline + subhead -> centered white rounded-5xl dual-CTA card: avatar proof row -> payoff headline -> subhead -> sky-gradient primary + coral-outline secondary dual buttons -> check reassurance row -> footnote under the card -> cream mini footer). All copy avoids em-dashes.

style.description: A warm, friendly, pastel-soft SaaS aesthetic where a cream paper field, frosted glass, and a sky-blue + coral-pink two-tone gradient do the work instead of hard color blocks. The palette is light and airy: a cream page #fdf9f3, a near-charcoal ink #27303f for text, a muted gray #6b7280 for body, and a two-accent gradient that pairs sky blue (sky #38bdf8, with shades 600 #0ea5e9, 700 #0284c7, 800 #075985, 900 #0c4a6e) with coral pink (coral #fb7185, with shades 600 #f43f5e, 700 #be123c, 800 #9f1239). The two accents appear together as gradients: the gradient-text headline phrase (linear 100deg #075985 to #0284c7 to #be123c), the sky-to-coral logo tile, and the sky-gradient primary button, while the secondary button uses coral outline. Hierarchy comes from soft shadow + glow depth and ink-opacity steps rather than many flat hues. One font does everything: Poppins (400-800), rounded and friendly, with the display headlines at 800 and tight tracking. The look is textured and soft: a faint dot grain overlay, a tri-radial pastel mesh tint behind the intro, generous border-radius (a 4xl 2rem and 5xl 2.75rem), big diffuse two-tone card shadows (sky + coral), inner blurred glows, frosted glass pills and nav, and small floating decor squares that gently bob. Buttons feel pillowy and physical: the sky-gradient primary and coral-outline secondary both lift 0.5 on hover with colored glow shadows. The mood is inviting and human, an infinite-canvas design tool selling 'a sentence to shippable UI', reassuring and playful rather than loud.

layout_and_structure.description: A real framed landing page read as a soft vertical stack: a glass sticky nav, a centered intro strip on a pastel mesh+grain tint (so the CTA has context above it), then the anchor centered dual-CTA card floating on cream with floating decor around it, a tiny footnote under the card, and a cream mini footer. Centered content lives in mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 for the nav/intro/footer, while the card section narrows to max-w-5xl px-6 and the card's inner copy to max-w-2xl / max-w-lg. It reflows cleanly to one column on mobile: the nav center links and 'Sign in' hide (logo + 'Start free' remain), the floating decor squares hide on small screens (lg:block only), the dual buttons stack full-width (flex-col items-stretch -> sm:flex-row), the reassurance row wraps, and the footer goes column.

Inside mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 pt-20 pb-10 text-center: an inline-flex rounded-full eyebrow pill (bg-white/70 px-4 py-1.5, 13px font-600 text-sky-800, .ring-soft) with a leading 15px ph:star-four-fill and 'The AI design agent on an infinite canvas'. Then a mx-auto mt-7 max-w-3xl Poppins h1 (font-800 tracking-tight, leading-[1.05], text-[40px] sm:text-[52px]) 'From a sentence to a ' + a .gradient-text whitespace-nowrap 'shippable UI'. Then a mx-auto mt-5 max-w-xl 17px leading-relaxed text-muted subhead: 'Describe it, watch it appear. Lumina turns plain-language prompts into mockups, components and full flows you can hand straight to code.'

prompts.prompt: The anchor section (id='cta') relative overflow-hidden bg-cream pb-28 pt-6. First, three pointer-events-none floating decor tiles, hidden on mobile and lg:block: an h-16 w-16 rounded-3xl bg-sky/15 .ring-soft .float-slow at left-[6%] top-10; an h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-coral/20 .ring-soft .float-slower at right-[7%] top-24; an h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-sky/20 .ring-soft .float-slow at bottom-16 right-[16%] (.float-slow / .float-slower = a translateY(-10px) bob keyframe over 7s / 9s). Then a mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 holding the card: a relative overflow-hidden rounded-5xl border border-white bg-white/90 p-8 sm:p-12 lg:p-16 with .shadow-card (the two-tone sky+coral diffuse shadow) and .ring-soft. Inside the card, two pointer-events-none inner glows: an absolute -left-16 -top-16 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-sky/20 blur-3xl and an absolute -bottom-20 -right-10 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-coral/20 blur-3xl. All card content sits in a relative text-center wrapper above the glows.

prompts.prompt: Inside the card, centered: a mb-7 flex items-center justify-center gap-3 proof row = a flex -space-x-2 stack of three 32px (h-8 w-8) avatar circles with white ring-2 (a sky one 'A', a coral one 'J', an ink one 'M', each white 12px font-700), then a -ml-1 cream +9k chip (grid h-8 min-w-[2.5rem] px-2 place-items-center rounded-full bg-cream text-ink ring-2 ring-white 12px font-700 .shadow-chip), then a 14px font-500 text-muted 'builders shipping with Lumina'. Then a mx-auto max-w-2xl Poppins h2 (font-800 tracking-tight, leading-[1.08], text-[34px] sm:text-[46px]) 'Build your first design ' + a .gradient-text whitespace-nowrap 'this afternoon'. Then a mx-auto mt-5 max-w-lg 17px leading-relaxed text-muted subhead: 'Start free, no card needed. Or grab a guided walkthrough and we will set you up. Either way, you will have something real on the canvas in minutes.'

A mt-10 flex flex-col items-stretch justify-center gap-3.5 row that becomes sm:flex-row sm:items-center. PRIMARY = a sky-gradient pill 'Start free': group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-800 to-sky-900 px-8 py-4 16px font-700 text-white, .shadow-btn (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(14,165,233,0.55)), ring-1 ring-inset ring-white/15, with an inner top sheen (a pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1/2 bg-white/[0.05]), a leading 20px ph:lightning-fill, the label, and a trailing 18px ph:arrow-right-bold that translate-x-0.5 on group-hover; hover deepens the gradient and -translate-y-0.5. SECONDARY = a white coral-outline pill 'Book a demo': group inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-coral-700/35 bg-white px-8 py-4 16px font-700 text-coral-700, .shadow-btn-coral (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(244,63,94,0.40)), a 20px ph:calendar-check-fill icon; hover:border-coral-700 hover:bg-coral/5 -translate-y-0.5.

Below the buttons, a mt-7 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 reassurance row (13.5px font-500 text-muted) of three inline-flex items, each with a leading 16px text-sky-600 ph:check-circle-fill: 'Free forever plan', 'No credit card', 'Export to code'. Then, OUTSIDE the card, a mt-8 text-center 13.5px text-muted footnote: 'Trusted by indie hackers, design teams and the folks who would rather ship than fuss.'

A footer with border-t border-ink/5 bg-cream. Inside mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 py-8: a flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 row. LEFT = a flex items-center gap-2.5 brand mark: a 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-lg gradient tile (bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral text-white) with a 15px ph:sparkle-fill, beside a 15px font-600 'Lumina'. CENTER = a 13px text-muted copyright 'Copyright 2026 Lumina Design. Made for people who ship.' RIGHT = a flex items-center gap-4 text-muted social row of three 20px Iconify links (ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:discord-logo) that go to text-ink on hover.

special_ui_components.prompt: The star is a big white card floating on cream that reads as a soft, lifted object: a relative overflow-hidden rounded-5xl (2.75rem radius) card with border border-white, bg-white/90, generous p-8 sm:p-12 lg:p-16, a hairline .ring-soft (box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(39,48,63,0.06)), and a big diffuse TWO-TONE drop shadow .shadow-card = 0 32px 80px -32px rgba(56,189,248,0.30) (sky) layered with 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(251,113,133,0.18) (coral), so the card glows softly in both accent colors at once. Inside, two pointer-events-none blurred glows bleed from the corners (an h-56 w-56 sky/20 rounded-full blur-3xl at -left-16 -top-16, a coral/20 one at -bottom-20 -right-10); overflow-hidden clips them to the rounded card edge. All content sits in a relative text-center wrapper above the glows.

Two pillowy rounded-2xl buttons offered as two paths. PRIMARY = a sky-gradient pill: bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-800 #075985 to-sky-900 #0c4a6e, white font-700, a colored glow shadow .shadow-btn (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(14,165,233,0.55)), an inset ring-1 ring-white/15, an inner top sheen (absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1/2 bg-white/[0.05]) for a glossy top, a leading ph:lightning-fill and a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges translate-x-0.5 on group-hover; hover deepens the gradient (from-sky-900) and lifts -translate-y-0.5. SECONDARY = a quiet white coral-outline pill: bg-white, border border-coral-700/35, text-coral-700 font-700, a coral glow shadow .shadow-btn-coral (0 10px 24px -8px rgba(244,63,94,0.40)), a ph:calendar-check-fill icon; hover:border-coral-700 hover:bg-coral/5 and -translate-y-0.5. Only the primary is filled, so the two-path choice stays clear.

A .gradient-text utility clips a warm two-accent gradient onto a single headline phrase (whitespace-nowrap so it never breaks mid-gradient): background linear-gradient(100deg, #075985 0%, #0284c7 42%, #be123c 100%) with -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent. Used to pop one phrase per headline ('shippable UI' in the hero, 'this afternoon' in the card) so the eye lands on the payoff word while the rest stays ink. The same sky-to-coral pairing appears as the logo tile gradient and informs the sky-gradient primary button.

A translucent sticky header (.nav-blur = backdrop-filter: saturate(160%) blur(12px)) over bg-cream/80 with a border-b border-ink/5, so cream content shows softly through on scroll. The same frosted-on-light language repeats in chips: the intro eyebrow is a rounded-full bg-white/70 .ring-soft pill, and the card proof row ends in a cream +9k chip with a white ring-2 and .shadow-chip. The brand mark is a sky-to-coral gradient rounded tile + a Poppins wordmark; the right side ends in a solid dark-ink 'Start free' pill anchored to #cta.

The intro strip gets soft atmosphere from two stacked background utilities: .mesh = three radial-gradients (sky/22 at 18% 12%, coral/20 at 88% 22%, sky/16 at 50% 110%, each fading to transparent by ~60%) for a faint two-tone pastel wash, plus .grain = a radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(39,48,63,0.05) 1px, transparent 0) tiled at 22px 22px for a fine paper texture. Together they tint and texture the area above the card without any hard color block, keeping the whole page soft and airy.

Three small pointer-events-none rounded tiles bob gently around the card on large screens only (lg:block): an h-16 w-16 rounded-3xl bg-sky/15 at left-[6%] top-10, an h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-coral/20 at right-[7%] top-24, and an h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-sky/20 at bottom-16 right-[16%], each with a .ring-soft hairline. Two animation utilities drive them via a single @keyframes float (translateY(0) -> translateY(-10px) -> translateY(0)): .float-slow runs it over 7s, .float-slower over 9s, so the tiles drift at slightly different rhythms for a light, playful feel.

structured.special_notes: Palette is cream + ink + a sky/coral two-tone gradient: cream #fdf9f3 (page), ink #27303f (headings), muted #6b7280 (body/subheads), and the paired accents sky #38bdf8 (shades 600 #0ea5e9, 700 #0284c7, 800 #075985, 900 #0c4a6e) and coral #fb7185 (shades 600 #f43f5e, 700 #be123c, 800 #9f1239). The two accents are always used TOGETHER as gradients/glows, never as flat color blocks: the .gradient-text headline phrase is linear-gradient(100deg, #075985 0%, #0284c7 42%, #be123c 100%); the logo tile and footer mark are bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral; the primary button is bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-800 to-sky-900; the card's signature shadow is two-tone (sky #38bdf8 at 0.30 + coral #fb7185 at 0.18). One Google font: Poppins (weights 400;500;600;700;800) for everything, headlines at font-800 + tracking-tight (hero 40/52px leading-1.05; card h2 34/46px leading-1.08), body at 17px text-muted. Icons are Iconify Phosphor: ph:sparkle-fill (logo), ph:star-four-fill (eyebrow), ph:lightning-fill + ph:arrow-right-bold (primary button), ph:calendar-check-fill (secondary), ph:check-circle-fill (reassurance row), ph:x-logo / ph:github-logo / ph:discord-logo (footer). Custom utilities carry the soft look: .grain (dot texture), .mesh (tri-radial pastel tint), .gradient-text (clipped headline gradient), .nav-blur (frosted nav), .ring-soft (1px hairline shadow), and @keyframes float with .float-slow (7s) / .float-slower (9s); custom radii rounded-4xl (2rem) / rounded-5xl (2.75rem); custom shadows shadow-card / shadow-card-sm / shadow-btn / shadow-btn-coral / shadow-chip. The signature language is a centered dual-CTA card floating on a cream field with a soft two-tone shadow, inner sky/coral glows, and bobbing decor squares, above it a mesh+grain-tinted intro strip, all in friendly rounded Poppins with one gradient-clipped headline phrase. To transfer the STYLE: keep cream + ink + the sky/coral two-tone gradient (used only as gradients/glows, never flat blocks), the single rounded Poppins font, the big soft two-tone card shadow + inner glows, the frosted glass nav/chips, the dot grain + pastel mesh texture, and the playful floating decor. To transfer the LAYOUT: keep the framed stack (glass sticky nav -> mesh+grain intro strip with frosted eyebrow + huge headline + subhead -> centered white rounded-5xl dual-CTA card: avatar proof row -> payoff headline -> subhead -> sky-gradient primary + coral-outline secondary dual buttons -> check reassurance row -> footnote under the card -> cream mini footer). All copy avoids em-dashes.
